sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: Udyam Registration, also known as MSME Registration, is a new way for small and medium-sized businesses to get registered in India. It was started by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises. After registration, the business gets a permanent number and a digital certificate.

Before July 2020, there was a different registration called Udyog Aadhaar, but now it has been replaced by Udyam registration in India. This new process is easier. Udyam registration is important because it allows businesses to take advantage of various schemes of the Ministry of MSME.
Loans without the need for collateral and with lower interest rates from banks and financial institutions.
A simpler process for getting licenses, permits, registrations, and approvals.
Discounts of up to 50% on trademark and patent registration fees.
MSMEs having certificate of Udyam registration in Indiacan obtain ISO certification for free of cost which increases their credibility in the market.
Udayam registration allows businesses to get waiver in the government security deposits while participating in any government tender.
Udyam-registered businesses get various tax benefits which advances financial stability of the organisations.
Enterprises having Udyam registration in Indiareceive subsidy on electricity and water bills.
Udyam Registration provides delayed payment redressal system for businesses hence providing them a financial security.
Some of the features of Udyam registration certificate are mentioned below:
You will get a permanent registration number for your business by the Udyam registration.
It is an e-certificate that will be issued to you via email after successful registration on the website of MSME ministry.
The Udyam registration in Indiais required only once and you will not be required to obtain this certificate again.
You will not be required to get separate Udyam certificate for various activities of your business. All activities of your business will be covered in one Udyam registration certificate.
